CHIEF COMPLAINT
Status post mitral valve repair follow-up.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Ms. Melissa Sanchez is a 63-year-old female presenting for follow-up evaluation after mitral valve repair performed on 8/3/2020. She reports feeling significantly better overall since her surgery and is pleased with her recovery. She continues to experience occasional chest discomfort and shallow breathing, which are exertional in nature. When these symptoms occur, they typically last only a few minutes and resolve with rest and activity modification. She reports experiencing these episodes approximately a couple of times per month, with symptom-free intervals lasting a couple of weeks. Patient has learned to manage her symptoms by slowing down when she experiences chest discomfort or dyspnea, and is usually able to resume her activities afterward. She denies any new cardiac symptoms. She reports good medication compliance using a reminder app to stay organized with her medications.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Positive for occasional exertional chest discomfort and exertional dyspnea, both with prompt resolution. Negative for palpitations, syncope, or other cardiopulmonary symptoms. Reports initial irritability associated with atenolol which has since resolved. Denies other medication side effects.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY
- Mitral regurgitation
- Atrial fibrillation
- Diabetes mellitus
- Asthma
- Recurrent chest discomfort with prior negative cardiac workup for coronary artery disease
- Status post mitral valve repair (8/3/2020)

MEDICATIONS
- Coumadin 4 mg daily
- Lasix 4 mg daily
- Atenolol 50 mg daily

ALLERGIES
Not documented.

FAMILY HISTORY
Not discussed.

SOCIAL HISTORY
Patient is working to maintain activity as tolerated and learning what her body can handle. She is adaptive with her activity level based on her symptoms. She reports good compliance with medications and uses a reminder app to maintain her medication schedule.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION
General: Appearing well
Head and Neck: No jugular venous distention
Lungs: Reduced breath sounds; auscultation and percussion clear
Heart: Rhythm irregularly irregular; S1 slightly accentuated; no S3
Abdomen: Non-tender
Extremities: Trace peripheral edema

RESULTS
Electrocardiogram: Atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response. T-wave inversion anteriorly. No significant changes compared to previous study from 12/26/2020.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN
63-year-old female status post mitral valve repair in August 2020, presenting for cardiology follow-up. Currently doing well with good recovery from surgery. Heart valves are functioning well. Atrial fibrillation is being well controlled on current medical management. Continue current medications: Coumadin 4 mg daily, Lasix 4 mg daily, Atenolol 50 mg daily. Encourage continued activity as tolerated. Follow-up appointment in 6-9 months. Patient instructed that no earlier return visit is necessary at this time given stable cardiac status.
